name: File Preview
tagline: See the PDF or image in a File or Image column on the form — and download, replace or remove it.
summary:
Shows the file in a File or Image column right on the model-driven form: a PDF in the browser's own viewer, an image at full size, the first 64 KB of a text or CSV file. The platform's own control shows only the file's name and a button.

- **Download** and **Open** on every file, under its real name, including names with accents or other scripts
- **Replace** and **Remove** when you switch them on, by choosing a file or dropping one on the preview, with Remove behind the platform's confirmation
- Refuses a file before uploading it when the column's size limit or the organisation's blocked file types would reject it, and says which
- Shows the full-size copy of an Image column when the column keeps one
- A file over 25 MB is offered for download rather than previewed

No manifest can bind a File or Image column, so the control is placed on any other column of the form and reaches the file through the record. **Model-driven apps only**; on the phone app a PDF is offered to open or download instead of being drawn.

limitations: A PDF is not drawn in the demo. The demo runs in a sandboxed frame, and Chrome will not run its PDF viewer in one, so the control shows the card it shows anywhere a PDF cannot be drawn, with Open and Download. On a model-driven form the PDF is drawn inline in the browser's viewer.
Open and Download are reported to the demo page rather than opening a tab or saving a file. On a form they hand the file to the platform, which opens it in a new tab or saves it under its name.

The demo's Dataverse is a fixture held in your browser: one account with a contract PDF, a storefront photo (full size and thumbnail), a CSV price list and an empty column. Replace and Remove go through the same requests a form sends and are answered from that fixture, refusals included: a file over 1 MB, a blocked type such as .exe, and a non-image into the photo column. Nothing is saved; Reset or a reload puts it back.

The platform File control a form often carries beside this one is not there, so the demo cannot show what a form does after a Replace: the platform's control keeps showing the old file until the page is refreshed.

presets.name: An image
presets.description: An Image column that keeps full-size copies: the full photo, not the 144-pixel thumbnail the column also holds. View only, the default.

presets.name: A PDF
presets.description: A contract in a File column. On a form the PDF is drawn inline; in the demo's sandboxed frame it is offered to Open and Download instead.

presets.name: A CSV file
presets.description: A price list: a text file shows its first 64 KB as text.

presets.name: Replace and remove
presets.description: Allow replace and remove on. Choose or drop an image to replace the photo, or Remove it behind a confirmation. Try a text file or anything over 1 MB to see the refusals.

presets.description: An empty File column with changes on: drop a file on it, or choose one. Up to 1 MB; .exe and the other blocked types are refused before anything is sent.
